answer: Social Matters >> Clothing & Lifestyle Question ID: 27388 Country: United Kingdom Title: What if beard is only growing on side? on ear sides? can it be trimmed to look better. hoping to keep 1fist once grow all everywere. people make fun ? Question: what if beard is only growing on side? on ear sides? can it be trimmed to look better. hoping to keep 1fist once grow all everywere. people make fun Answer ID: 27388 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1969/1573/B=1431) It is not lawful to cut the beard growing on any part of the jaw. However, if it exceeds one fist then you can cut it. You cannot cut it due to the pretext of people making fun of it. Yes, you can use medicine in order to grow the hair for the part where it does not grow. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
